blurb: Guests rent various types of boats such as pontoons, tri-toons, bowriders, and sundecks for daily or half-day use. Boats come equipped with GPS navigation, Bluetooth stereo, coolers (no ice), and Coast Guard required safety equipment. Popular boating destinations include Charlotte Harbor and nearby islands for swimming, dining, and shopping.
